name: Niger
build: built: the Charte de la Refondation of 26 March 2025 (constitutional value, in force); 246 laws, ordinances, decrees and arrêtés (1960-2025) from FAOLEX, the Conseil d'Etat and the Ministry of Mines, each one version as published, dated by the date of the text; and six earlier one-version texts: Constitution consolidated to 2018 (suspended in 2023); Code pénal consolidated to 2018 (replaced in 2026); Code de procédure pénale to 2004; Code du travail as enacted in 2012; charter of political parties to 2019; electoral code to 2019. Later changes are not represented.
